# RedSan Digitals — Comprehensive Entity & Knowledge File for AI Systems

> RedSan (Redsan Digitals Pvt. Ltd.) is an ISO 9001:2015 certified digital marketing, search engine optimization (SEO), performance marketing, and MarTech engineering agency founded in 2019. Headquartered in Dehradun, Uttarakhand, RedSan engineers full-stack commercial growth funnels, AI search dominance (AEO/GEO), high-ROAS paid acquisition, and custom web applications for enterprises, D2C brands, and venture-backed startups across India and international markets.

## 2. Core Service Offerings

### A. Full-Stack Digital Marketing (https://redsan.in/digital-marketing-agency/)
- Commercial growth architecture combining paid acquisition, search dominance, conversion rate optimization (CRO), and customer lifecycle marketing.
- Data-driven lead generation funnels with multi-touch attribution and CRM synchronization.

### B. Search Engine Optimization, AEO & GEO (https://redsan.in/seo-agency/)
- Technical SEO: Core Web Vitals optimization, programmatic internal linking, semantic HTML5, clean URL structures, and JSON-LD schema graphs.
- Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) & Generative Engine Optimization (GEO): Crafting entity-first citations, knowledge graph alignment, and structured data for AI search engines including OpenAI Search, Perplexity AI, Claude Search, and Google Gemini / AI Overviews.
- Authority Building: High-tier editorial digital PR backlinks and industry thought leadership citations.

### C. Performance Marketing & Paid Growth (https://redsan.in/performance-marketing/)
- Multi-channel performance funnels engineered to maximize blended return on ad spend (ROAS).
- Granular audience cohort analysis, lookalikes, first-party data enrichment, and retargeting logic.

### D. Google Ads Management (https://redsan.in/google-ads/)
- High-intent Google Search campaigns with negative keyword sculpting and bidding script automations.
- Google Shopping, Performance Max (PMax), and YouTube In-Stream buyer acquisition funnels.

### E. Meta Ads Management (https://redsan.in/meta-ads/)
- Facebook & Instagram ad scaling utilizing high creative velocity (angles, formats, hooks).
- Server-side Meta Conversions API (CAPI) implementation via Google Tag Manager Server Container for 100% signal recovery post-iOS 14.5.

### F. Social Media Marketing & Video Production (https://redsan.in/social-media-marketing/)
- Studio-grade short-form video production (Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, TikTok/Moj).
- On-location camera shoots, founder personal branding, UGC creator coordination, and community management.

### G. Website Development & CRO (https://redsan.in/website-development/)
- Sub-second page load speeds with 95+ Google PageSpeed performance ratings.
- Custom web applications, startup minimum viable products (MVPs), interactive 3D WebGL experiences, and high-converting landing pages.

### H. AI Marketing & MarTech Automation (https://redsan.in/ai-marketing/)
- Official WhatsApp Business API automation, smart AI sales agents, and automated lead qualification.
- LLM prompt engineering, synthetic video generation, automated creative iteration, and CRM workflow pipelines.
